description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_ValidatorAtom class, which provides an immutable fluent interface for validating scalar member variables in a configuration context for HTMLPurifier. It includes validation methods such as type checks, nullity, alphanumeric string validation, and lookup array validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_ValidatorAtom
classes.description: A class providing validation methods for scalar configuration member variables within the HTMLPurifier configuration schema.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with context, object, and member name, and references the member contents.

methods.name: assertIsString
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are a string.

methods.name: assertIsBool
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are a boolean.

methods.name: assertIsArray
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are an array.

methods.name: assertNotNull
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are not null.

methods.name: assertAlnum
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: assertNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are not empty.

methods.name: assertIsLookup
methods.description: Ensures that the member contents are an array of lookup values, with each element strictly equal to true.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an exception with an error message if validation fails.
